reason: Version 4 sounds like a teammate talking. It uses 'we're,' says 'the only big piece left,' and ends with 'on track to hit Nov 3,' and it is still the clearest of the four. Versions 1 and 3 add the redundant 'target date' and read more like a report than a Slack message.
